title: feat(pm): the workflows row lands Tier S unless its diff trips a release path or a C2 trigger
body:
domain:skills#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jT34CXs5fCn3BDirZw

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbQPUFkmB2t4gDe9p5ntfxAL)_

Fixes #31538

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:objectstack 仓的 `.github/workflows/**` 改为按 diff 内容定落地档。6 个发布/部署/写中继文件,以及改权限、密钥、新 action、删 job、改必查名、新 continue-on-error、改 if 的改动仍需你批(Tier H);其余改动凭达档复核 PASS 由席位落地(Tier S)。队列守卫、AGENTS.md §14、pm-dispatch 技能同步改。
- **为什么改**:落实 #31538 的裁决 C(记录 6722205630):超时、缓存键、路径过滤、已在用 action 的版本升级这类小改不再排队等人批;能关掉别的门禁的改动照旧人合。
- **风险与回滚**:风险是把危险改动误判成 S。凡读不出 diff、解析不了、没有基线、或拿不准的情况一律判 H(清单见 Acceptance notes)。回滚 = revert 本 PR,工作流行回到整行 Tier H。
- **先看**:`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` 的 `workflowDiffReasons` 与 `WORKFLOW_TIER_H_FILES`;`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` 的 `attachWorkflowReadings`;`AGENTS.md` §14 改的两行。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`,预期两行 ✓,分别 609 条与 433 条。
- **需要你做的**:暂无。本 PR 整体 Tier H,contract review owed;复核 PASS 后席位请你批准。

## What changes

1. **`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`** — the `workflows` register row gains `split: { repos: ['objectstack'], reader: 'readWorkflowDiff' }`. Its `tier` stays H, so every path-only reader (and objectui, cloud) keeps answering H. With a reading of the diff, `applyWorkflowSplit` sets the row's tier per PR:
   - **Tier H by path** (`WORKFLOW_TIER_H_FILES`, any edit):
     - `release.yml`: publishes the packages and queues the `release` deployment (Prime Directive #15).
     - `docker-publish.yml`: pushes the runtime image (`push: true`, `packages: write`).
     - `framework-build-base.yml`: pushes the framework build base image (`push: true`, `packages: write`).
     - `docs-deploy.yml`: deploys the docs site (`vercel deploy --prebuilt`, the deploy token).
     - `checklist-status.yml`: publishes the checklist status pages to the wiki (`contents: write`).
     - `fleet-write.yml`: the fleet's write relay and its App key. Biased to H: it holds the credential; it is not a release.
   - **Tier H by diff (C2)**: an added or changed `permissions:`; a `secrets` or job-token line (`github.token` in any case, any `github[…]` index, `toJSON(github)`) added, changed or moved; `pull_request_target`; a `uses:` (or container image) not used anywhere under `.github/workflows` or `.github/actions` at the merge base; a deleted job, a changed literal check-run name, or a changed `needs:` (added or lost); a new `continue-on-error`; an `if:` the base does not hold for the same owner with the same text, unless its job is new on the head.
   - **Tier S** otherwise.
   - The reader is a dependency-free line-model YAML reader, because the guard's `pull_request` leg runs before any install. It **fails closed**: tabs, anchors, aliases, tags, merge keys, multi-document markers, flow mappings other than `{}`, flow collections spanning lines, unclosed quotes, double-quoted escapes (`\x`, `\u`, `\U`…), lines led by a YAML indicator (`? permissions`) and a child under a node with a scalar value are all refused, and refused is H.
   - `--branch` and `--pr` read the diff (`--pr` only when the checkout holds both commits). `--test` has paths only, so it always says H. Verdicts print one split line naming the reasons.
2. **`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`** — `attachWorkflowReadings` reads each queued commit against its first parent (`merge_group`) or the merge base (`pull_request`). `decomposeGovernedWork` then takes the tier from the reading. A measured Tier S entry goes to the existing review-of-record leg. A commit it could not read, including a second commit of the same PR, stays Tier H.
3. **`AGENTS.md` §14** — the Tier H and Tier S clauses name the split. Two lines are edited in place; no line was added and nothing was re-wrapped.
4. **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`** — 〈受管面两层〉 now names the split in one new line. That line is paid for by deleting `- 批准判定单源 = 队列守卫常量 GOVERNED_APPROVERS…不卡 commit_id`, whose surviving copy is `AGENTS.md:288` ("authorized APPROVED review by an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, on ANY commit and not dismissed"). The file stays at its 319-line ceiling, and every line is ≤120 B.
5. **`.github/CODEOWNERS` is unchanged.** The mirror self-test reads each row's register `tier`, and that tier is still H, so the mirror still requires `/.github/workflows/`, and it stays green. CODEOWNERS is a static path file that cannot read a diff. Routing a Tier S workflow PR to the approvers is a request, not a barrier, so this errs toward over-summoning, which is the safe direction.

## Why

Ruling record 6722205630 (letter C, maintainer 「同意」) on #31538: split workflow landing, keep the edits that can switch other gates off at Tier H, and move the rest to Tier S.

## Tests

- `check-governed-merges --self-test`: 543 → 609 assertions. New battery `⭐ the workflows split…`: 66 cases. Battery floor 35 → 36.
  - Trigger → pin:
    - permissions → `C2-permissions-added-is-H`, `C2-a-changed-permissions-key-is-H`
    - secrets → `C2-a-secrets-reference-added-is-H`, `C2-a-github-token-reference-added-is-H`
    - pull_request_target → `C2-pull_request_target-is-H`
    - new `uses:` → `C2-a-uses-no-workflow-on-the-base-uses-is-H`
    - deleted job → `C2-a-deleted-job-is-H`
    - check-run name → `C2-a-literal-check-run-name-changed-is-H`
    - continue-on-error → `C2-a-new-continue-on-error-is-H`
    - disabling `if:` → `C2-an-if-that-disables-a-step-is-H`, `C2-an-if-that-disables-a-job-is-H`, `⛔ M1-a-renamed-gate-step-given-if-false-beside-a-dummy-under-the-old-name-is-H`, `⛔ M1-a-gate-step-re-keyed-by-an-id-and-given-if-false-is-H`, `⛔ M1-a-new-step-with-its-own-if-inside-an-existing-job-is-H`
    - changed `needs:` → `biased-a-needs-that-lost-a-job-is-H`, `⛔ S1-a-needs-added-on-an-existing-job-is-H`
    - reader refusals → `⛔ M2a-a-flow-mapped-step-is-refused-and-H`, `⛔ M2b-a-double-quoted-escape-spelling-a-key-is-refused-and-H`, `⛔ M2b-an-escape-inside-a-value-is-refused-too`, `⛔ M2d-an-explicit-key-line-is-refused-and-H`, `⛔ M2d-a-child-under-a-node-with-a-scalar-value-is-refused-and-H`
    - credential spellings → five `⛔ M2c-a-credential-spelled-…-is-H` pins (`Secrets.`, `SECRETS.`, `github['token']`, `GitHub.Token`, `github . token`) and two `⛔ D2-the-job-token-reached-as-…-is-H` pins (`toJSON(github)`, `github[format(…)]`)
    - a gate moved out of an existing job → `⛔ D1-a-gate-step-moved-into-a-new-job-with-if-false-is-H`, `⛔ D1-a-gate-step-moved-into-a-new-job-behind-an-opt-in-needs-is-H`, `⛔ D1-a-uses-moved-out-of-an-existing-job-is-H`
    - path → `six-files-are-Tier-H-by-path-release-docker-base-image-docs-wiki-and-the-write-relay`, `a-pinned-file-is-H-even-on-a-comment-only-edit`
  - Near-misses, each Tier S: a moved `if:` that disables nothing, a `uses:` bump of an action already in use, a timeout edit, a path-filter edit, a shard count inside a computed matrix name, a cache-key edit, a comment edit, and a new job with a fresh name and its own `if:`. Controls that must still parse: `{}`, an expression value, a plain-scalar continuation.
  - Fail-closed pins: no reading, an unmeasured reading, no base, git throws, unparseable YAML, a new file, a deleted file, a non-YAML file.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --self-test`: 403 → 433 cases. New battery `⭐ the workflows split at the queue (ruling record 6722205630)`: 30 cases. Battery floor 29 → 30. Ablation: raising the battery's pin to 31 turns the run red.
  - An S reading makes the entry Tier S and clears on a valid record with zero approvals, through the real recognisers.
  - The same entry is refused with no record, and a Tier H reading with only a record is refused.
  - A second commit of the same PR that was not read makes the entry H, and objectui and cloud stay H.
  - The fake-git reader takes the first parent on `merge_group` and the merge base on `pull_request`, reads the inventory once, and treats an unresolved parent as H.

## Acceptance notes

- **Replay on the last 40 workflow-touching merges** (37 had workflow paths on the first parent; re-run after each review round, same 13): 13 come out Tier S at the workflow row (#27115, #27709, #30714, #27018, #27122, #27400, #27571, #28089, #29326, #30869, #31086, #31133, #31138) and 24 stay Tier H. #27400 and #31133 stay Tier H as whole PRs because they touch other Tier H paths. The most common H reasons were an `if:` not held on the base (31 hits), a changed `needs:` (12, the `schedule-gate` wiring), a new `continue-on-error` (9, the lint.yml collector idiom), a gate or action no longer held by an existing job (9, lane rebalancing), a pinned path (8), a dropped gate invocation (6) and permissions (3).
- **Cases biased to Tier H**, because this surface can switch the other gates off:
  - a changed job, step or workflow that holds a secret or a write token
  - an added `|| true`, `set +e`, `exit 0`, or an `OS_SKIP_` / `OS_DISABLE_` / `OS_ALLOW_` variable
  - a dropped gate invocation (`check:*`, `scripts/*.mjs`, `pnpm <script>`, `turbo run X`, vitest, eslint, tsc, playwright, lychee), from the file or from an existing job (a gate moved into a new job that never runs)
  - a dropped `uses:` or image, from the file or from an existing job
  - a changed `needs:`, added or lost
  - a changed trigger set
  - a changed workflow name
  - a new job whose check-run name is computed or collides with an existing one
  - a new, deleted or non-YAML workflow file
  - `fleet-write.yml` and `checklist-status.yml` by path
  - any `if:` the base does not hold for the same owner and text, inside a job that already existed (a step's owner is a name the author picks)
  - container images treated like `uses:`
  - `--test` mode always, and `--pr` unless the checkout holds both commits
  - objectstack's `ui/.github/workflows/**` row (not split) and the objectui and cloud rows
- **Known limit, S by the ruling:** the text of a `run:` / `shell:` edit is not judged beyond a dropped gate token or an added risky pattern (`echo "pnpm check:x"`, `|| :`, `shell: bash {0}` read S); the contract review of record is the control.
- **Follow-ups, all outside this card's file surface:**
  - `.github/actions/**` is not a register row yet feeds the "already in use" inventory (review N3); the seat files the card.
  - A cross-repo card is owed for item 4 of #31538 (cloud and objectui). The seat files it.
  - `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs` `governedReviewPlan` is still path-only, so a Tier S workflow PR still has the approvers requested on it. That is an over-summon, not a barrier.
- No new gate, no gate skipped or made report-only, no required context dropped, and no merge-queue setting changed.

## Verification

- Head 09522452e (both review rounds' fixes, with main merged at 8784ccbce) — `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 46 commands. All 46 exited 0, and `--ran` reconciled 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:doc-formula-expressions` ran after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`. `eslint` on the two scripts is clean.
- All 32 workflows and 3 local actions on the tree still parse under the stricter reader, and a differential against the `yaml` library shows 0 files with differences.
- At the earlier head 268167fbd, I also ran the roster gates whose roster is under a touched directory. Ten exited 0. `check:published-readme-exports` exited 3 (NOT MEASURED: it needs every published package built), and this diff publishes nothing.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `eslint` on the two changed scripts passes (the whole-repo `pnpm lint` is left to CI).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the `## 维护者速读` block is Chinese by os-dev.md's rule).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
